blocks.challenge: High volume of mixed inbound email inquiries — leads, technical questions, and noise — required manual reading, classification, and routing daily. Inconsistent handling and missed messages were a recurring problem.
blocks.built: AI classification of all inbound email into actionable categories. Automatic CRM logging. Draft response preparation for relevant inquiries. Human review and approval preserved on every outbound action.
blocks.result: Zero emails missed or misrouted. Staff time freed from manual sorting. Human decision retained on every reply. | Operational consistency achieved from day one of go-live.
